status: research recommendation; not implemented or scientifically validated by this audit
input: Reviewed source-scoped Workflows, States, Operations, Flows, original evidence, and a versioned concept catalogue.
target: Explicitly scoped, evidence-supported concept memberships and region correspondences while preserving each source occurrence.
invariants: No cross-method material/data flow is introduced merely by shared wording or concept membership.
Shared purpose, mechanism, semantic scope and experimentally contextual substitutability remain distinct claims.
Unknown is not equality or a wildcard assertion of compatibility; not_assessed remains distinguishable.
New local States and Operations may be authored independently; new shared definitions require retrieval and explicit proposal/review.
Connected regions can contain unequal operation counts; do not invent hidden intermediates for alignment.
Rare source-supported mechanisms are retained without a minimum-frequency rule.
Record and review versions remain immutable; hashes identify exact objects, not semantic classes.
recommended_process: Extract local Workflow without forcing existing vocabulary.
Profile comparison-relevant input/output identity, transformation, information linkage, routing and context with per-assertion evidence/status.
Retrieve candidates with lexical and semantic channels from occurrence neighborhoods and concept definitions.
Compare shortlists in context, including close negative alternatives and source excerpts; return explicit typed relation, coverage, differences and unknowns.
Check independent source review; existing review evidence does not automatically support a new shared claim.
Queue unmatched proposed definitions; reconcile against existing and concurrent proposals outside write locks.
Commit reviewed mappings against the latest compatible catalogue generation; remap affected earlier records after definition changes.
minimum_experiment: Label-only retrieval versus full-text hybrid retrieval versus faceted/contextual hybrid retrieval using the same downstream reviewer.
Small exhaustive comparison subset to measure candidate recall, not merely accepted-match precision.
Paraphrase, same-label/different-context, same-purpose/different-mechanism, unknown-interface, rare-concept and composite-operation cases.
Registry/candidate order permutation and concurrent duplicate-proposal tests.
Independent expert audit at the end, including model-accepted, rejected, unresolved and rare cases; withhold suggestions initially for a subset.
metrics: candidate recall at the inspected shortlist size
source-audited false merge and false separation rates
limits: Human-centered methods inform traceability and evaluation design; continuous human curation is not assumed.
Screening covered 2025/2026 conference and journal sources, plus older close precursors; not an exhaustive systematic review.
This audit did not execute external model pipelines or promote new graph edges.
